Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for a great discovery call today — appreciated the context on Acme's regulatory constraints and the expected throughput for your inference workloads. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap (high level):
- Primary use case: private inference for customer-facing search + classification (peak 150 tps, typical 40 tps).
- Data controls: VPC-only access, KMS for key management, 3-year retention requirement.
- Success criteria: <=150ms p50 latency on 2k token sequences, dedicated capacity with predictable throughput, SOC2 controls and audit logs.

Next step: schedule a 60-min Private/VPC architecture review and technical deep dive with your CloudOps and Security folks. Suggested agenda:
1) Goals & constraints (10m)
2) Target topology and network requirements (15m)
3) Authentication/KMS and audit/logging (15m)
4) Ops: scaling, upgrades, and rollback strategies (10m)
5) Action items & timeline (10m)

Availability: I have open slots next week — Wed 11/11 9:00-11:00 PT or Thu 11/12 10:00-12:00 PT. If neither work, feel free to pick a slot from my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/scheduling/marissa/30min (I can extend to 60m on booking).

Attached are the discovery notes and a short checklist we typically use to prepare for the architecture review. Please loop in any additional folks from CloudOps or InfoSec who should attend.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
